name: Dominican Republic COVID-19 Citizen Oversight Commission
content: Problems and Purpose As stated in the decree (145-20) through which the Covid-19 Citizen Oversight Commission was created, five representatives from different civil society groups were designated by the President as members who would monitor government purchases and contracts during the pandemic. The following organizations are represented in the Commission: The National Council of Private Enterprises, the Dominican Confederation of Small and Medium Enterprises, the Evangelical Churches, the Catholic Church and the Dominican Newspaper Association.
